subject: ela
intro: Every informational text is about one big idea called the main topic. The key details are facts that tell more about that topic. To find the main topic, ask: 'What is this mostly about?' Then find two or three details that support it.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Dogs make great pets. They are friendly and loyal. Dogs can be trained to do many things. Some dogs help police officers find missing people.

What is the main topic of this article?

steps: I ask myself: what is every sentence in this article about?
Sentence 1: Dogs make great pets.
Sentence 2: They are friendly and loyal.
Sentence 3: Dogs can be trained.
Sentence 4: Some dogs help police officers.
Every sentence is about dogs and what they can do.
The main topic is dogs.
solution.answer: The main topic is dogs and why they make great pets.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

The sun is a star. It is very hot and very bright. The sun gives Earth light and warmth. Without the sun, nothing on Earth could live.

Name one key detail from this article.

steps: I know the main topic is the sun.
I look for a fact that tells more about the sun.
I see: 'The sun gives Earth light and warmth.'
This is a detail because it tells me something the sun does.
Another detail is: 'Without the sun, nothing on Earth could live.'
solution.answer: One key detail is that the sun gives Earth light and warmth.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Water is important for all living things. People need water to drink. Plants need water to grow. Animals need water to survive.

What is the main topic? Name two key details.

steps: I ask: what is every sentence about?
Every sentence is about water and why it is important.
The main topic is: water is important for living things.
Detail 1: People need water to drink.
Detail 2: Plants need water to grow.
Both details support the main topic.
solution.answer: The main topic is that water is important for all living things. Two details are: people need water to drink, and plants need water to grow.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Sharks are amazing hunters. They have rows of sharp teeth. Their sense of smell is very strong. Sharks can smell blood from far away.

Which sentence best states the main topic?

steps: I look for a sentence that covers what the whole article is about.
The first sentence says: 'Sharks are amazing hunters.'
The other sentences all give details about why sharks are good hunters: sharp teeth, strong smell.
The first sentence covers the big idea, so it is the main topic sentence.
solution.answer: The sentence 'Sharks are amazing hunters' best states the main topic.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Spring is a time of new growth. Flowers start to bloom. Baby animals are born. Trees grow new green leaves.

What is the main topic? Name three key details.

steps: I ask: what is every sentence about?
Every sentence is about things that happen in spring.
The main topic is: spring is a time of new growth.
Detail 1: Flowers start to bloom.
Detail 2: Baby animals are born.
Detail 3: Trees grow new green leaves.
All three details tell about new growth in spring.
solution.answer: The main topic is that spring is a time of new growth. Three details are: flowers bloom, baby animals are born, and trees grow new green leaves.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Horses are useful animals. Farmers use horses to pull heavy loads. People ride horses across long distances. Horses also help in races and shows.

What is the main topic of this article?
items.hint: Ask yourself: what is every sentence in this article about?

steps: Every sentence talks about horses and what they are used for.
The main topic is: horses are useful animals.
solution.answer: The main topic is that horses are useful animals.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Healthy eating helps your body grow strong. Fruits and vegetables give your body vitamins. Whole grains give you energy. Drinking water keeps you hydrated.

Name two key details from this article.
items.hint: Look for facts that tell more about healthy eating.

steps: The main topic is healthy eating helps your body.
Detail 1: Fruits and vegetables give your body vitamins.
Detail 2: Drinking water keeps you hydrated.
Both details support the main topic.
solution.answer: Two key details are: fruits and vegetables give your body vitamins, and drinking water keeps you hydrated.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Rain forests are home to many animals. Colorful parrots live in the treetops. Jaguars hunt on the forest floor. Thousands of insects crawl through the leaves.

What is the main topic? Name one key detail.
items.hint: The first sentence often gives the main topic.

steps: The first sentence gives the main topic: Rain forests are home to many animals.
One detail: Colorful parrots live in the treetops.
This detail gives an example of an animal that lives in the rain forest.
solution.answer: The main topic is that rain forests are home to many animals. One detail is that colorful parrots live in the treetops.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

The post office helps people send mail. Workers sort letters into groups. Mail carriers deliver letters and packages. People can also buy stamps at the post office.

What is the main topic?

steps: Every sentence is about the post office and what it does.
The main topic is: the post office helps people send mail.
solution.answer: The main topic is that the post office helps people send mail.

items.prompt:
Read the article below.

Volcanoes can be dangerous. They shoot hot lava into the air. Ash from a volcano can cover the sky. The ground shakes before a volcano erupts.

Name three key details from this article.
items.hint: Look for three facts that support the idea that volcanoes are dangerous.

steps: The main topic is: volcanoes can be dangerous.
Detail 1: They shoot hot lava into the air.
Detail 2: Ash from a volcano can cover the sky.
Detail 3: The ground shakes before a volcano erupts.
solution.answer: Three key details are: volcanoes shoot hot lava into the air, ash can cover the sky, and the ground shakes before an eruption.
